timeline.message:
Fix regression introduced by 042f0c8

Closes GH-34770
timeline.author: Yanming Zhou

timeline.body: For a bootstrapNode with a value of "PLAINTEXT://localhost:9092" this implementation will return a Node with a host of "PLAINTEXT://localhost" and port of "9092". I am not sure that the host part is ok since I guess it should be just "localhost".

reply.body: I think it should include protocol part to restore server node from `Node` object, maybe the `host` should rename to a more meaningful name.

timeline.body: Thanks for the PR, but as indicated by the labels and comments on #34774, we're not yet ready to implement a fix for this.
